intent.raw: $refine what is missing for grant work feeding the DAG, adapter alternatives, knowledge feedback, outcome measurement, component charts, and split development projects; then invoke refresh the goldenquill-promotion-governance folder.
intent.objective: Produce a strategy proposal and proposal-only refresh plan that clarifies the grant-work DAG cycle before mutating canonical artifacts.
intent.operator_sentence: Refine and refresh GoldenQuill promotion governance around the whole grant-work learning cycle.

route_menu.context_hint: The target combines architecture gaps, refresh deltas, and project slicing; use the canonical Refine loop before execution.

items.label: Event-first refresh
items.description: Treat adapters as typed event producers and refresh the architecture around projection, metrics, and learning feedback.

items.label: Direct DAG writers
items.description: Let each component write DAG nodes directly; keep simpler but accept tighter coupling.

items.label: Memory-first learning
items.description: Prioritize cross-cycle knowledge writes before DAG projection; likely unsafe for promotion governance.

technique_overlays.trigger: The missing piece is the hidden cycle between grant work, DAG events, adapters, metrics, governance, and future grant work.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The route must emit an architecture handle that names components, adapters, events, projectors, and feedback loops.

technique_overlays.trigger: Adapter integration has multiple plausible shapes: event-first, direct writers, command API, batch import, or memory-first.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Rejected alternatives must be recorded with trade-offs, not erased.

technique_overlays.trigger: Existing GoldenQuill strategy evidence includes Reflection Packet, memory query, Brain/JIT research, CycleReceipt, and dormant cross-cycle learning.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Prior research is cited as source evidence and unresolved deployment constraints remain residue.

technique_overlays.trigger: Grant work contains org-scoped feedback, private source documents, portal exports, and operator decisions.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Event, adapter, and knowledge-feedback proposals must preserve org scope and owner approval boundaries.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The cycle crosses architecture, grant operations, metrics, privacy governance, and implementation slicing.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Sibling role review would reduce blind spots before canonical mutation.

roles.purpose: Map components, adapters, events, projectors, and feedback loops.
roles.owns: architecture structure findings and component-chart risks

roles.purpose: Check grant lifecycle, outcome, cost, relationship, and stewardship measurement semantics.
Verify promotion authority, org scope, redaction/generalization, and owner-decision boundaries.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirm before running delegated subagents or runtime-backed Refine stages.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: block if target inventory cannot be resolved

steps.name: Invoke Define missing cycle concepts
stop_conditions: block if concepts cannot preserve event, adapter, metric, and promotion boundaries

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
stop_conditions: block if promotion authority is assigned to adapters, KPIs, or memory writes

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: ask before external research if a named external gap appears

steps.name: Distill architecture unit and alternatives
convergence_criteria: Keep adapters out of promotion authority
Support fixture-only L0 and future production ingestion
Allow knowledge feedback into future grant work only after owner-approved governance

steps.name: Invoke Design full cycle architecture
stop_conditions: block if design lacks component chart, adapter chart, feedback chart, or project split

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: block if event, adapter, metric, governance, and memory authorities are ambiguous

steps.name: Distill Repair
stop_conditions: block unresolved authority errors before planning

steps.name: Invoke Plan project split
stop_conditions: plan must split into self-contained development projects with validation evidence

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: final synthesis must name next route and avoid applying refresh without approval

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json validates against dispatch.schema.yml and technique governance.
Runtime-backed stages and delegated subagents require explicit confirmation after the strategy proposal.
Refresh remains proposal-only until apply-approved is explicitly granted.
Adapters, events, DAG nodes, KPIs, and memory evidence cannot approve reusable knowledge.
Org-scoped grant feedback must remain private unless redacted/generalized and owner-approved.

authority.lifecycle: GoldenQuill owns grant workflow lifecycle; Refine owns only this strategy proposal.
authority.execution: Task Session owns any future implementation execution from an approved work-pack.
authority.validation: dispatch-spec validates route shape; GoldenQuill validators validate event, DAG, KPI, and governance fixtures.
authority.evidence: GoldenQuill source refs, portal exports, cycle receipts, reflection packets, and refresh signals remain evidence handles.
authority.memory: GoldenQuill memory query and approved reuse packets consume owner-approved learning only.
authority.promotion: Ontology Vault layer and OwnerDecision own promotion authority and approved allowed uses.

state_namespaces.write_policy: write only generated proposal artifacts under the run folder before confirmation
write refresh report and patch proposal only; no canonical target mutation

promotion_splits.rule: source evidence may propose but never approve reuse

promotion_guardrails: No canonical SPEC, architecture, domain, workflow, event, mapping, operation, or test artifact is mutated in proposal-only mode.
No adapter is allowed to bypass typed event validation and write owner-approved learning directly.
No KPI threshold creates approved allowed uses.
No memory or knowledge write becomes workspace-safe without redaction/generalization and owner decision.
